title: Alfie Gunfibel first meeting

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I mean how are you doing emotionally? Mentally? Commercially?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean how are you doing emotionally? Mentally? Commercially?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Sure. That's the most important one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. That's the most important one.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I want to enable you to overcome any obstacles in your path and help you to achieve your true potential. I want to remove any impediments to your career and professional growth while nurturing your emotional wellbeing and spiritual integrity. I want to... I can't remember the rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to enable you to overcome any obstacles in your path and help you to achieve your true potential. I want to remove any impediments to your career and professional growth while nurturing your emotional wellbeing and spiritual integrity. I want to... I can't remember the rest.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I wish. I'm a part of the Sanguine Minds Therapy project.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wish. I'm a part of the Sanguine Minds Therapy project.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: It's a... well "punishment" isn't exactly the right word. But if you owe the Society of Therapists money, joining this programme is mandatory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a... well "punishment" isn't exactly the right word. But if you owe the Society of Therapists money, joining this programme is mandatory.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I accidently signed up for one of those "reduce your stress" workshops. Half an hour later, they hit me with a bill for half a mil. I'm paying it off one session at a time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I accidently signed up for one of those "reduce your stress" workshops. Half an hour later, they hit me with a bill for half a mil. I'm paying it off one session at a time.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Want to be one of my clients? No charge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Want to be one of my clients? No charge.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Oh don't be like that! Come on. Don't you want to be one of my clients? No charge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh don't be like that! Come on. Don't you want to be one of my clients? No charge.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I don't think I'm ready for such direct rejection. Which, ironically, is why I started therapy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think I'm ready for such direct rejection. Which, ironically, is why I started therapy.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Nice! Well before we get properly started, you should know that our particular form of therapy is more effective than any other in helping you force down all your emotions, bury your problems - for good - and become productive once more!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice! Well before we get properly started, you should know that our particular form of therapy is more effective than any other in helping you force down all your emotions, bury your problems - for good - and become productive once more!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Alright! Well I should probably put together a personalized development plan to help you overcome your issues and remain productive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright! Well I should probably put together a personalized development plan to help you overcome your issues and remain productive.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: But in the meantime there are some little exercises and mantras I can teach you to help in the short term. Ready?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But in the meantime there are some little exercises and mantras I can teach you to help in the short term. Ready?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: There are two wolves inside you. One is love and one is hate. They both agree that your productivity must improve.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are two wolves inside you. One is love and one is hate. They both agree that your productivity must improve.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I have a mantra you can repeat. "Every mountain starts with a single step."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a mantra you can repeat. "Every mountain starts with a single step."

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Right. Well, I'll get you registered and set up as a client. Next time we chat, we can begin in earnest. Thanks for joining me on the road to success!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Well, I'll get you registered and set up as a client. Next time we chat, we can begin in earnest. Thanks for joining me on the road to success!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: It is what it is. Well I should probably put together a personalized development plan to help you overcome your issues and remain productive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is what it is. Well I should probably put together a personalized development plan to help you overcome your issues and remain productive.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Good point. I promise I won't charge you half a mil later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good point. I promise I won't charge you half a mil later.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: No, but I'm still contractually bound to ask. How are you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, but I'm still contractually bound to ask. How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this some kind of cult?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this some kind of cult?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is this some kind of cult?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is this some kind of cult?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you owe therapists money?
